full_details: In the morning you were back in Verona, with the king off your hands until Thursday. She has heard that her cousin is dead and by whose hand. You found a passage that told the yard what the yard had already seen, and you struck it, eleven lines. You left her one turn and fewer words. The margin says trust the boy. Because the reckoning is at five, you put the sheets under the cloth and went to play. At two you played Egeon. Across the water the Rose had Crack Me. You did not cross. At five John set the share at thirty-four shillings, the best since Whitsun. Kemp told yours out with the name. You took the stack home. You did not open the coffer. It stands at twenty pound fifteen. You entered thirty-four beside last Saturday's twenty-nine, and you added nothing.
one_sentence: You struck eleven lines, left her one turn, and at five the share was thirty-four shillings, the best since Whitsun.
title: Thirty-four shillings at five
